description: The classic naval battle — place your 5 ships, then hunt the computer's fleet on a 10×10 grid with hit, miss, and sunk tracking.

faqs.a: Carrier (5), Battleship (4), Cruiser (3), Submarine (3), and Destroyer (2) — 17 ship cells each side.
faqs.q: Which ships are in the game?

faqs.a: Pick a ship, choose horizontal or vertical, and click your grid — or press Auto-place to deploy instantly.
faqs.q: How do I place my ships?

faqs.a: It uses hunt-and-target tactics: random probing, then zeroing in on neighbors once it scores a hit.
faqs.q: How smart is the computer opponent?

faqs.a: Sink all 5 enemy ships before it sinks yours. Sunk ships are announced in the battle log.

howto: Place your 5 ships manually or press Auto-place.
Press Start Battle when your fleet is deployed.
Tap enemy waters to fire — 🔥 hit, · miss.
Sink all 5 enemy ships before yours are sunk!
title: Battleship Game
